name: reachcast
title: ReachCast
description: A Raycast extension that turns reusable templates into Gmail-ready messages in seconds.
author: nishilfaldu

commands.name: create-gmail-message
commands.title: Create Gmail Message
commands.subtitle: Fill a template and open Gmail
commands.description: Generate a Gmail-ready email from reusable templates and custom fields.

commands.name: edit-email-template
commands.title: Edit Email Template
commands.subtitle: Customize subject and body
commands.description: Edit the reusable Gmail template with a multiline body editor.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
